## Recitals

**A.** \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ (the "Contributing Member") is a Member of the Company.

**B.** The Contributing Member has created, and owns individually, the project known as
**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**, together with its source code, project files, source
assets, design documentation, build and packaging tooling, and associated names and marks
(collectively, the "Project"), as described in Schedule 1.

**C.** Section 7.2 of the Operating Agreement provides that a Member may, at their sole
discretion, contribute a project they have created into the Work Pool; that the project
enters the Work Pool only on the contributing Member's voluntary act **and** the
Committee's acceptance under Section 5.3(3); that the Committee accepts a project only
after the contributing Member discloses every third-party, marketplace, open-source, and
AI-generated component in it together with the license terms for each; and that the
disclosure goes into the manifest maintained under Section 10.1.

**D.** The Contributing Member has voluntarily offered the Project to the Company and has
delivered the disclosure required by Section 7.2, attached as **Schedule 2** and recorded
in the [IP Manifest](Records/IP-Manifest.md).

---

## Consent and Resolutions

The undersigned, being the Member or Members whose consent the basis checked above
requires, hereby consent to and adopt the following:

**1. Voluntary contribution acknowledged.** The Contributing Member's offer of the
Project to the Work Pool is voluntary, made under Section 7.2 at the Contributing
Member's sole discretion, and is not required by any provision of the Operating
Agreement, by any Company policy, or as a condition of membership.

**2. Disclosure received and found sufficient.** The disclosure attached as Schedule 2
identifies every third-party, marketplace, open-source, and AI-generated component known
to the Contributing Member to be present in the Project, and the license terms each is
held on. Acceptance under Section 7.2 is made on the strength of that disclosure.

**3. Representations of the Contributing Member.** The Contributing Member represents, as
required by Section 7.2, that they own the Project; that it carries no security interest
and no third-party claim; and that the disclosure in Schedule 2 is complete and accurate
to their knowledge as of the Consent Date. The Contributing Member further represents that
no part of the Project is encumbered by a contributor's retained rights (Section 3.7) and
that the Project is not, and has never been, pledged, mortgaged, or offered as collateral
for any obligation (Section 9.4).

**4. Acceptance into the Work Pool.** The Project, as described in Schedule 1, is
**accepted into the Work Pool** under Sections 5.3(3) and 7.2, effective on the Consent
Date.

**5. Transfer of ownership.** On acceptance, all intellectual property in the Project
transfers to the Company and becomes Company IP held in trust for the equal benefit of all
Members (Sections 7.1, 7.2). The Contributing Member makes a present assignment of that
intellectual property to the Company by the separate
[Work Pool Contribution and Assignment](Work-Pool-Contribution-Agreement.md) executed
alongside this Consent, and will execute any further documents reasonably needed to
perfect or record the Company's ownership, including any assignment recordable with the
United States Copyright Office or the United States Patent and Trademark Office.

**6. Irreversibility acknowledged.** Contribution is irreversible. Once in the Work Pool,
the Project is Company IP and is governed by Article 7. The Contributing Member does not
retain an ownership interest in it and holds instead the perpetual license of Section 7.3,
on the same terms as every other Member.

**7. License consequences.** The Project is Company IP for all purposes of Section 7.3
from the Consent Date forward. Every Member's perpetual license refreshes to cover it, and
every Member's delivery right under clause 7 of Section 7.3 — repositories with history
intact, project files, and source assets in their working formats, each delivery carrying
its manifest — attaches to it. Components held on third-party terms that do not permit a
Member's Section 7.3 use are identified as such in the manifest; the Company's acceptance
does not, and cannot, enlarge those terms.

**8. Records.** The Secretary shall (a) enter the Project on the Work Pool list in the
[Member Register](Records/Member-Register.md), (b) record the Schedule 2 disclosure in the
[IP Manifest](Records/IP-Manifest.md) under Section 10.1, noting for each component whether
its terms permit a Member's Section 7.3 use, and (c) keep this Consent and the executed
assignment with the Company's records.
